resourceSystem.title: Anatomical Loadout
resourceSystem.description: Prepare three two-slot loadouts at a completed long rest. At most two anatomical slots are active at once. Adopting costs 1 AP and adds one unrecovered transition; at three transitions it is refused until you recover by suspending a real trait. Plating prevents 2 per own-turn window; Living Brace prevents 4 once.

cards.title: Slots (0-2)
cards.details: Locomotion, offense, defense and senses. Never two traits in the same slot. A suspended trait grants nothing.

cards.title: Transitions (0-3)
cards.details: Each adoption adds one transition. At three, adoption is refused until recovery. Reconnect or rest cannot erase recorded transitions except a completed long rest.

cards.title: Prepared Bodies
cards.details: Predator (locomotion/offense), Bastion (defense/senses) and Mimic (locomotion/senses). Preparation does not grant optional spells.

rows: Replace the active two slots; record the new traits
Suspend one active trait until your next own turn
Leave the prior anatomy unchanged; no AP or trait is lost
Return to the default body and clear suspensions

overheatRules.title: Anatomy Overflow
overheatRules.content: A third active trait or a second trait in the same slot is rejected without changing the existing body. At three unrecovered transitions, adoption is refused; the prior anatomy, AP and traits remain unchanged. A completed long rest returns the default body and clears suspensions, but never invents a new prepared loadout.

resourceSystem.title: Quarry & Evidence
resourceSystem.description: Designate one exact quarry. Read, Angle and Pressure are distinct evidence tags with recorded sources; at most one new tag is generated per own turn. Spend listed tags on tactics. Evidence expires after two own turns without contact.

cards.title: Quarry (0-1)
cards.details: Changing quarry clears all evidence. Investigating an unknown trail never invents an exact combat identity.

cards.title: Evidence (0-3)
cards.details: Each tag records its source event and own turn. A duplicate tag does nothing and spending a tag never refreshes generation.

cards.title: Companion
cards.details: A real bonded and trained companion shares the one-tag cap and spends its own action. No fabricated pet or free creature turn.

rows: Take an Angle with 10 ft legal movement
Press the Quarry with an accepted non-miss hit
Companion study or accepted pack hit
Duplicate tag, miss or ordinary movement
No tag; AP is still spent when the action was paid

overheatRules.title: Quarry Overflow
overheatRules.content: A second quarry is rejected without changing the first; changing quarry is always deliberate and clears all evidence. A fourth evidence tag or duplicate tag is rejected. A third own-turn tag is impossible because generation is capped at one. A missing companion disables companion actions only, never the solo economy.

shaper.notes: Druid is the transformation name. Keep prior martial/body state and IDs resolvable; no Flux/stance -> anatomical-slot conversion. Bladedancer/Monk are separate reviews.

formbender.notes: Historical Formbender identity merged into the Druid design; raw IDs remain resolvable.

apex.notes: Preserve old marks/companion/spec/save IDs, including Nereid variants; never conjure a new actor from an old counter.
